pkgmetadata.longdescription: Monstar is a native Wayland terminal emulator built on libghostty, CPU-rendered (like foot). It features fractional scaling, IME, activation and background blur, Kitty graphics, OSC 8 hyperlinks, scrollback search and rectangular block selection, XDG desktop portals and optional D-Bus/systemd integration. It is written in Zig and built with the zig build system.
